label: Sampled-value functions
subgoals: Compare each cycle's value with the previous cycle's value
Assume the stated value before cycle 0
Count the cycles where the requested change or non-change occurs

label: Concatenation with cycle delays
subgoals: Slide the sequence's start along the trace
Check each element at its offset from the start
Count the start cycles whose whole pattern fits and matches

label: Consecutive repetition
subgoals: Expand the repetition range into its alternatives
Check each alternative from the start cycle
Count the start cycle once if any alternative matches within the trace
